import datetime, json, pathlib, signal, sys, time
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from ec2_instances_probe import InstanceCapture, interrupt
from ebs_encryption_probe import CONFIG, now

args=SimpleNamespace(region='us-east-1',output=pathlib.Path('testdata/aws/ec2/instance_status_xen.json'),cleanup_only=False,audit_only=False,live_seconds=600)
c=InstanceCapture(args)
c.clients['cloudwatch']=c.session.client('cloudwatch',config=CONFIG)
c.data.update(scope='One t2.nano Xen guest with one 8-GiB gp3 root; actual status and CloudWatch applicability; no SG ingress/egress or public networking',guest_program=None)
c.data['bounds'].update(max_simultaneous_instances=1,instance_type='t2.nano')
c.data['documentation']=['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitoring-system-instance-status-check.html','https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/viewing_metrics_with_cloudwatch.html#status-check-metrics']
c.save()
for signum in (signal.SIGALRM,signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM): signal.signal(signum,interrupt)
try:
    c.deadline=time.monotonic()+600
    signal.alarm(600)
    c.setup()
    c.ec2('xen-hardware','describe_instance_types',{'InstanceTypes':['t2.nano']},required=True)
    request=c.request(); request.update(InstanceType='t2.nano',BlockDeviceMappings=request['BlockDeviceMappings'][:1])
    request.pop('UserData'); request.pop('IamInstanceProfile')
    started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    c.data['experiment_started_at']=started.isoformat(); c.save()
    # Fixed one-instance request; inherited observation retains all cleanup ownership.
    iid=c.ec2('launch-one-xen-guest','run_instances',request,required=True)['Instances'][0]['InstanceId']
    c.state(iid,'running','xen-running')
    first_healthy=None
    for attempt in range(18):
        result=c.ec2('xen-status-'+str(attempt),'describe_instance_status',{'InstanceIds':[iid],'IncludeAllInstances':True},required=True)
        print(json.dumps({'at':now(),'status':result},default=str),flush=True)
        row=result['InstanceStatuses'][0]
        if row['SystemStatus']['Status']=='ok' and row['InstanceStatus']['Status']=='ok':
            first_healthy=first_healthy or time.monotonic()
            if time.monotonic()-first_healthy>=120: break
        time.sleep(20)
    if first_healthy is None: raise RuntimeError('No healthy Xen status observed in bounded capture')
    for metric in ['StatusCheckFailed','StatusCheckFailed_System','StatusCheckFailed_Instance','StatusCheckFailed_AttachedEBS']:
        c.observe('xen-metric-'+metric,'cloudwatch','get_metric_statistics',{'Namespace':'AWS/EC2','MetricName':metric,'Dimensions':[{'Name':'InstanceId','Value':iid}],'StartTime':started,'EndTime':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc),'Period':60,'Statistics':['Minimum','Maximum','SampleCount']},required=True)
    c.data['capture_complete_at']=now(); c.save()
except BaseException as error:
    c.data['failure']={'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error),'at':now()}; c.save(); raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    for signum in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM): signal.signal(signum,signal.SIG_IGN)
    c.cleanup()
    print(json.dumps({'cleanup':c.data['cleanup'],'output':str(args.output)},default=str),flush=True)
